title: The Age of the Fading Dawn
description: The Crimson Veil is thinning at an alarming, unprecedented rate, causing the substance of the Dreaming (Oneiros) to bleed into the Waking World (Mundus) with every sunrise. Geographic Anchorstones are failing, and Nightmares begin to manifest physically at dawn, receding only partially as the day progresses.
premise: The Crimson Veil is thinning at an alarming, unprecedented rate, causing the substance of the Dreaming (Oneiros) to bleed into the Waking World (Mundus) with every sunrise. Geographic Anchorstones are failing, and Nightmares begin to manifest physically at dawn, receding only partially as the day progresses.
narrative_direction: From a stable, if fragile, dualism to a state of accelerating, chaotic merger. The world is reacting to a crisis, trying to preserve the old order.
unresolved_mysteries: What is causing the Veil to thin? Is it a natural cycle or an engineered event?
What is the true origin and purpose of the Anchorstones?
plot_hooks: The Great Anchorstone of the central continent shatters, causing a permanent, miles-wide tear in the Veil.
The first major city is consumed by a 'Dawn Tide'—a wave of solidified dream-stuff that fails to recede.
central_conflict: The world-scale struggle to maintain the fundamental separation of Mundus and Oneiros against a relentless, natural decay of reality's boundary.
